Job Description: Senior Data Scientist AI/ML & GenAI

We are seeking a highly experienced Senior Data Scientist to lead the design, development, and deployment of advanced data-driven solutions leveraging cutting-edge AI/ML and Generative AI technologies. This role demands deep expertise in data profiling, data analysis, machine learning algorithms, and the practical application of GenAI models to solve complex business challenges.


You will be responsible for architecting robust data science solutions, guiding technical teams, and driving innovation across enterprise-scale analytics and AI initiatives. The role also involves collaborating with stakeholders, defining strategic data science roadmaps, and ensuring alignment with industry best practices and enterprise governance standards.

Responsibilities

Lead the end-to-end design and implementation of data science solutions for business-critical applications, ensuring scalability, performance, and compliance.
Conduct advanced data profiling, cleansing, and exploratory data analysis to uncover actionable insights and inform model development.
Develop, validate, and deploy AI/ML models (including supervised, unsupervised, and deep learning algorithms) using Python, R, and modern ML frameworks (e.g., scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch).
Design and implement Generative AI solutions (e.g., LLMs, RAG, AI agents) for enterprise use cases, leveraging platforms such as OpenAI, Azure AI, or AWS SageMaker.
Champion data governance, responsible AI principles, and model interpretability, ensuring solutions are ethical, transparent, and compliant with regulatory standards.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams (business, engineering, product, and leadership) to gather requirements and translate business needs into technical solutions and strategic data science roadmaps.
Provide technical leadership and mentorship across data science projects, conducting design reviews and enforcing development standards.
Architect and optimize data pipelines for model training, evaluation, and deployment, integrating with core business systems and cloud platforms.
Develop and maintain documentation for data science workflows, model architectures, and integration patterns.
Stay current with emerging trends in AI/ML, GenAI, and data engineering, acting as a subject matter expert and driving continuous innovation.

Required Qualifications

12+ years of overall IT experience, with 5+ years in data science, AI/ML, or advanced analytics roles.
Proven, hands-on experience designing and deploying solutions using:
- Data profiling and analysis tools (e.g., Pandas, SQL, Power BI)
- Machine learning frameworks (scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch)
- Generative AI platforms (OpenAI, Azure AI, AWS SageMaker)
- Python and R for data science and ML
Strong understanding of machine learning algorithms, model lifecycle management, and MLOps best practices.
Demonstrable experience in designing data governance, data strategy, and responsible AI frameworks.
Deep knowledge of cloud-native architecture and data engineering (Azure, AWS, or GCP).
Experience with data pipelines, feature engineering, and model deployment in production environments.
Familiarity with CI/CD, version control (Git), and Agile delivery models.
Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to present complex ideas to technical and non-technical audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

Advanced degree (PhD or Master’s) in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, or related field.
Certifications in Data Science, AI/ML, or cloud platforms (e.g., Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Scientist Associate, AWS Certified Machine Learning).
Experience with enterprise-scale data platforms (Databricks, Snowflake, Tableau, etc.).
Experience with GenAI, LLMs, and multi-modal AI use cases.
Prior experience in a consulting or client-facing role with large enterprise customers.
Knowledge of data privacy, security, and compliance standards (GDPR, HIPAA, etc.).

Ready to drive innovation and shape the future of AI and data science in our organization? Apply now to join our team as a Senior Data Scientist!
